facts.fact: GIZ states Ethiopia ratified its first Startup Proclamation in July 2025, recognising startups under a dedicated regulatory framework.

ETH.note: No statement that startups have been labelled or that a fund has financed them.

facts.fact: GIZ states 13 incubators and one accelerator run incubation and acceleration programmes, with 1,750 startups participating in 2020-2025.

ETH.note: No statement of hubs in several cities or a technology park with tenants.
